lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I got that photo you sent me.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Who is this?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: They look awfully pale, whoever they are.
It's a dead body we found at the place you told me to go.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Are you seriously sending me pictures of dead bodies?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Are you nuts?
Are you telling me you didn't know that this is what we'd find there?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Talking back to your predecessor, are you?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Back in my day, we wouldn't stand for such back talk.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Well, is this all you found?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Nothing else?
Answer my question.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I don't even know what the question is.
There was a corpse at the coordinates you provided.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: So?
I'm telling you someone died, and this is your only response?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: People die on the surface all the time, commanders included.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: What's the big deal?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Who is this, anyway?
We don't know yet.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I presume you've already checked the database?
We have, and there aren't any commanders on file who resemble this man.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: This doesn't make any sen...

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Wait a moment.
There is no response for a while.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: It's Hanson.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I can tell if I look closely enough.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: How did he put on so much weight?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Or more importantly, how come his body didn't decompose?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: This doesn't make any sense...
Explain yourself.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: What's there to explain? I'm just as confused as you are.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: This is crazy.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Let me organize my thoughts first.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I'll contact you later.
